description: Checks whether Libertas Insurance, a licensed independent agency, can quote and bind home, auto, or bundled (home + auto) insurance in the customer's state. A good first step when someone asks about insurance prices, switching carriers, or shopping for coverage, before collecting personal details. Pass the customer's two-letter state if you know it; otherwise the result lists the states Libertas serves so you can ask. Returns whether quoting and binding are available, plus a plain-language explanation.

intent.description: Whether you're checking ability to 'quote' or to 'bind' (default 'quote').

state.description: The customer's two-letter U.S. state, if known (e.g. 'TX').

name: check_eligibility

outputSchema.description: Whether quoting/binding is available for the customer's state + product.

title: Check eligibility
